description: CX-EDIT, the CommitTrans variant the first card left out: in a Workspace transaction on p1, parent Edit, a child AddNew/Value/Update ('c1'), CommitTrans while the parent is still in Edit, then parent Update; the group is read. Then on p2: BeginTrans, parent Edit, child AddNew/Update ('c2'), parent Update, CommitTrans (the earlier probe showed the parent Update ends the level); then on p3 a child-only edit without a parent Edit inside BeginTrans/CommitTrans. After each step Errors follow a marker error and the groups of all parents are read after a fresh Database open. Asks the commit behaviour of child edits against the parent edit state.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
